local _LXV_VM_KEY = "yfvppc3fn4e"
local _LXV_BYTECODE = ""

local function _LXV_VM_DECODE(bytecode, key)
    local decoded = ""
    local raw = game:GetService("HttpService"):Base64Decode(bytecode)
    for i = 1, #raw do
        decoded = decoded .. string.char(bit.bxor(string.byte(raw, i), string.byte(key, (i - 1) % #key + 1)))
    end
    return game:GetService("HttpService"):Base64Decode(decoded)
end

            setfenv(chunk, _LXV_PROXY_ENV)

    end
